meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,存在源文件旁边;如果配好 WOWerpoint 服务器,还会上传并返回一个手机端分享链接。它只做幻灯片,不出视频和播客。
howto.when: 当你说「Wowerpoint <文件>」「把这份报告做成幻灯片」「Kawaii-deck this」等,或要求把一份文档变成可分享的叙事幻灯片时接管。

say.note: 生成 kawaii 幻灯片 PDF,配好服务器则返回分享链接

say.text: 把 ~/docs/调研.md 做成一份幻灯片,用可爱角色讲清楚
say.note: 生成约 10 分钟,可先打开 notebook 链接看进度

say.text: 把这份白皮书做成幻灯片,提示词用「温暖清晰地讲故事」
say.note: 你给的提示词会原样传给生成引擎

howto.what_en: Turns a single document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF saved next to the source; if the WOWerpoint server is configured, it uploads the deck and returns a mobile share link. Slides only — not videos or podcasts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any ask to render one document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Kawaii slide-deck PDF; share link if the server is set up

say_en.text: Turn ~/docs/research.md into slides with cute characters
say_en.note: Generation takes about 10 minutes; watch the notebook link

say_en.text: Make a deck from this whitepaper with the prompt "tell it warmly"
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim
